name: Ginkouin ~Ochiyuku Onna-tachi~
source:
Main character spends days serving female vice branch manager. It has been great so far, but he demands more freedom. He brings another person to seduce her. Things become messy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公每天都在服侍银行的女副支行长。迄今为止一切都很顺利，但他想获得更多自由，于是找来另一个人引诱她。事情随即变得一团糟。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
